Jump back into the game and see all the new, wonderful changes we’ve made just for you!

With love,

notes.title: Happy First Anniverary of Girls! Girls! Girls!? Enjoy 30% off on us!
notes.content:
[b]Dearest fans,[/b]

Today marks a year since "[i]Girls! Girls! Girls!?[/i]" found its home on Steam, and what a journey it has been! From the first line of code to the last brushstroke, every moment has been a labor of love, made all the more special by your support and passion.

In celebration of this milestone, we're offering a heartfelt thank you with a [color=red][b]30% discount[/b][/color] on the game—the deepest discount we've ever had. It’s our way of saying thanks for the overwhelming love and camaraderie you've shown us.

Your enthusiasm has turned "[i]Girls! Girls! Girls!?[/i]" into more than just a game; it’s become a vibrant community of kindred spirits. Your reviews, your fan art, your lively discussions have been the lifeblood of this adventure, and we couldn’t be more grateful.

As we look back on the laughter, the tears, and the triumphs we've shared, we are reminded that this game is not just ours, but yours too. You've been with us every step of the way, believing in our vision and embracing the world we've built together.

[b]And now, a glimpse into the future that we are crafting with you in mind:[/b]

[u][b]Girls! Girls! Girls!? Rebirth Update:[/b][/u]
The much-anticipated Quality of Life update is on the horizon. With [b]4 new CGs plus an additional NSFW CG[/b], [b]3 new backgrounds[/b], and a [b]complete overhaul of the story[/b], we're deepening the lore and adding layers to every character, ensuring they have a special place in your heart.

While we aimed to deliver "Rebirth" in Q1, our commitment to making this update extraordinary means we're taking a little more time to polish and perfect. We're dedicated to minimizing bugs and maximizing magic, and we’re nearly there. Your patience means the world to us—it will be worth the wait.

[b][u]Merch Alert:[/u][/b]
Don't miss out on the "[i]Girls! Girls! Girls!?[/i]" Limited Edition Keychains and Acrylic Standees. Head over to [url=https://store.myosuki.com]our store[/url] while supplies last—these treasures are as fleeting as the moments they commemorate. Shipping begins next month!

[b][u]Expanding Our Horizons:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Localizations are underway! We're bringing the game to life in Japanese, Russian, and Spanish.
[*]Voice acting? It’s on the maybe-list. Imagine hearing your favorite characters like never before!
[*]Console porting is in progress, expanding our reach to gamers everywhere.
[/list]

As we look ahead, the promise of new endeavors fills us with excitement. Your passion fuels our creativity, and together, we'll keep building worlds that captivate and inspire.

Here’s to another year of stories, dreams, and the unwritten chapters that await us in "[i]Girls! Girls! Girls!?[/i]".

With all our hearts,
Toffee San and the Myosuki Team

notes.title: 1.2 Update: ADULT PATCH is now live on STEAM!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the release of the 1.2 December Update for "Girls! Girls! Girls!?" on Steam, and it's packed with exciting features! Most notably, we're introducing the Adult Patch, now available to all our players on Steam, completely free of charge. This update brings 10 additional H-Scenes, enhancing the narrative, deepening the storytelling and character experiences.

[b]To enable the Adult Content, simply go to Settings and check the "Enable Explicit Content" box![/b]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/38874654/80fbbbfbd4d62f029649a0ffdd78cf50a8c07abb.png[/img]

[b]Important Notice: [/b]With the addition of this substantial new content, the price of "Girls! Girls! Girls!?" will see an increase after the Steam Winter Sales, effective from January 5th, 2023. This means you have a golden opportunity right now to grab the game at a discounted rate. Don’t miss out on this chance to experience the full depth and excitement of "Girls! Girls! Girls!?" at the best price!

We're also excited to bring you the latest update for Girls! Girls! Girls!? – Version 1.2, live as of this December. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we've made some cool changes to enhance your gaming experience.

[b]What's Inside the 1.2 Update?[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Free Adult Patch[/b]: Delve into deeper, more mature storylines with our newly released Adult Patch. It's bold, it's daring, and it's here to add a sizzle to your gaming experience.
[*][b]Skip the Intro, Dive into Action[/b]: We know you love the story, but sometimes you just want to get right to the heart of the action. Now, you can skip the intro and opening videos for an even smoother start.
[*][b]Enhanced Scenes and Narratives[/b]: Every scene has been polished to perfection, ensuring each moment in the game is as engaging as it is visually stunning.
[*][b]No More Bugs[/b]: We've been on a bug-hunting spree to make your gameplay as smooth as silk.
[/list]

[b]Looking Ahead:[/b] Get ready for early next year, as we’re gearing up for some major updates, including the much-anticipated Quality of Life Update. We've got some big plans and can’t wait to share more details with you soon.

As always, thank you for your support, suggestions, and for being a part of the Myosuki community. Your passion drives us to continuously improve and evolve.

[i]Cheers,[/i]
[b]The Myosuki Team[/b]
